revise_description: To reflect a new parenting policy, the family must also decide the trip pace mode (budget, balanced, premium). Introduce binary mode variables and mode-dependent per-child costs with fairness and budget constraints using parameters pace_mode_*, fairness_penalty, max_total_cost, and min_children_per_mode.
